2.2 Tell Git who you are
Every commit records an author name and email. Set them once per computer:
$ git config --global user.name "Nguyen Van Minh" $ git config --global user.email "minh.nv@student.hcmus.edu.vn"

IN OUR COURSE Use your real name and the same email as your GitHub account . If the email does not match, GitHub cannot link your commits to your profile and your contribution will look like zero. This is the most common reason students "lose" credit.

Check your settings:
$ git config --global --list user.name=Nguyen Van Minh user.email=minh.nv@student.hcmus.edu.vn

chapter

Situation
Safe tools
Not

Committed,

Committed

and

pushed

(shared)

WARNING
Rewriting history that teammates already pulled (reset + push --force) breaks their repositories. On shared branches, always use git revert.

$ git restore src/planner.py

This throws away your uncommitted edits in that file and brings back the last committed version.
